sources.title: Chatterbox open source text to speech repository
sources.claim: The repository documents the Chatterbox model families and usage guidance. Model variants and controls should be checked against the installed version.

sources.title: Chatterbox Standard implementation
sources.claim: The implementation contains text normalization and synthesis controls; punctuation normalization can change the input text before synthesis.

scopeNote: The production settings in this article are the Fused local profile, not universal recommendations. No performance or quality statistics are asserted.
